causal_question: Can the direction-complete compact Pair-VQ representation that closed the full MLP also replace attention V and output projection without reopening the matched compact-parent loss gap?

theory.functional_object: For head h, the value-to-residual write depends on W_O[:, I_h] W_V[I_h, :] after attention mixing, not on either matrix in isolation.
theory.gauge: W_V,h -> G_h W_V,h and W_O,h -> W_O,h G_h^{-1} leave the head-local linear value/output composition unchanged for invertible G_h.
theory.prior_failure: Fixed BlockFHT charts missed useful ambient directions; direct int8 retraction discarded sub-quantum Muon motion and drifted late.
theory.prior_success: Full-dimensional int8 plus FP16 temporal error feedback closed V/output-projection quality, proving that support plus trajectory memory is sufficient but not compact enough. Pair-VQ plus forward-visible feedback and exact compact FP16 momentum then closed the full MLP across two matched seeds.
theory.candidate_mechanism: Use Pair-VQ as the only persistent matrix state for attention V and output projection, with the same forward-visible compact feedback and exact adaptive reserved-escape FP16 ambient momentum used by the qualified MLP. Q/K remains the accepted headwise BlockFHT mapper.
theory.why_this_is_not_another_fixed_basis: Pair-VQ codes and codebooks are refreshed from the requested ambient Muon trajectory and therefore do not restrict the weight to a fixed pseudo-random linear span. The exact compact momentum preserves temporal direction rather than reconstructing it from a fixed chart.
theory.scope_limit: The 0.5TPP rung can reject initialization or short-horizon incompatibility but cannot close attention because the historical full-attention gap grew only at longer horizons. A pass authorizes 124M/5TPP, then 20TPP; it never authorizes model-size scale-up.

frozen_configuration.candidate_change_only: replace dense attention V and dense attention output projection with Pair-VQ

representation.materialized_inference_flops: unchanged from the dense target attention and MLP

scientific_gates.next_on_pass: run the same 124M representation at 5TPP before any 20TPP or size transfer
scientific_gates.next_on_failure: localize attention V versus output projection under the same Pair-VQ state; do not change the MLP or scale
